items.title: 66095_Benny Carter oral history interview
items.q: I know Dick Klein was telling me that when, I believe it was "Sex and the Single Girl" ... he wanted that sound

ctx.x: But of course that's just one particular case.

That's one particular case, but of course I know that Neal Hefty was invited out there under somewhat similar circumstances, not by any instigation of mine, but I know Dick Klein was telling me that when, I believe it was "Sex and the Single Girl" ... he wanted that sound that Hefty had been getting, you know, with the Basie thing, and he just picked up a phone one day and called Neal Hefty in New York, and said, "How would you like to come out and work on a picture for me?" It was just like that, and he came --…
The Hollywood work goes on and off; I mean, it isn't something like a band where you're doing something every day and it's just a question of getting an assignment, so all this time ...
